policies_list.title: Policies
policies_list.heading: Policies
policy_form.intro: One Policy is the whole definition of how an item behaves: how often it is fetched, how it is processed, and how it is transmitted.
policy_form.fetch_legend: 1. Fetch — how often the source is polled
policy_form.process_note: Runs once when new data arrives.
policy_form.transmit_legend: 3. Transmit — how the item goes on air
adapter_import.title: Import adapter
adapter_import.intro: Upload a single adapter's JSON export (from the Export link on an adapter's row) to add it to this install. A brand-new adapter is imported immediately; importing over an existing source or a CUSTOM adapter's code asks for confirmation first.
adapter_import_preview.title: Preview adapter import
adapter_import_preview.intro: Nothing has been written yet. Review below, then confirm to import.
adapter_import_preview.skipped: This file could not be imported: {reason}
adapter_import_preview.skipped_custom_wa: This is a CUSTOM adapter, so it will be skipped — enable {link} on this install to import it. Its Python code is never read or executed either way.
adapter_import_preview.custom_warning: This is a CUSTOM adapter — operator-authored Python, executed with no sandboxing on every poll once imported. Review the code below before confirming.
adapter_import_preview.overwrite_warning: An adapter named '{source}' already exists on this install and will be overwritten.
adapter_import_preview.confirm_overwrite: I understand this will overwrite the existing adapter with this source.
